articles.title: Why Are So Many Countries Suddenly Leaving the World's War Crimes Court?
articles.summary: Chad just became the fifth country to quit the International Criminal Court (ICC) in recent months. The court, which puts war criminals on trial, is facing accusations of bias and heavy pressure from the United States. Venezuela also left, saying the court isn't fair.

articles.title: The Giant Telescope That Spied on Soviet Missiles Might Be Shut Down Forever
articles.summary: The famous Jodrell Bank telescope in the UK, which has explored distant galaxies for nearly 70 years, could stop working in 2028 due to funding cuts. Scientists say it's a heartbreaking mistake. The telescope even helped track Soviet missiles during the Cold War and is a UNESCO World Heritage site.

articles.title: A 3,000-Year-Old City Gets a Superhero Shield!
articles.summary: UNESCO just added the ancient site of Sebastia to its World Heritage list—and its danger list! Israel wants to take over the land, but Palestinians hope this will protect the Roman ruins and olive trees. Can a title really stop bulldozers?
